title: Best Dog Food (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Picks were made by comparing the four brands tested in Holistic Digest’s 2026 review (We Feed Raw, Maev, Ollie, JustFoodForDogs).
assumptions: Prices are not provided in the sources, so cost comparisons are based on relative value claims only.

verdict.line: We Feed Raw is best for dogs that need a nutrient‑dense, minimally processed diet. It offers the highest ingredient quality and the best value among the tested brands, but it can be more expensive than some kibble options.
